name: arm up rotator stretch
source_instructions: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, palm resting on your upper back.
Use your other hand to hold the elbow.
Gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
interpretation: One representative side in a five-second demonstration: left arm elevates through an outside forward arc, elbow folds behind the crown until palm rests on upper back, then opposite hand approaches and cups elbow from a posterior plane. Brief gentle assisted hold with ribs down/chest open; release reverses the clear route. Source workout hold is20–30 seconds, then mirror sides.
